title: SegmentedControl
description: A single-choice segmented switch for modes and filters, with a thumb sliding under the selected segment. Use Tabs when each choice has its own content panel.

support.notes: Single-choice segmented switch from string/object options (icon, label, disabled, aria-label), controlled/uncontrolled value, three sizes, neutral/primary thumb, fullWidth, disabled and an equal-width sliding thumb. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports roving arrows (left-to-right only) and Home/End selection; native hosts use touch selection. Segments always share the width equally. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: SegmentedControl
translationResources.description: A single-choice segmented switch for modes and filters, with a thumb sliding under the selected segment. Use Tabs when each choice has its own content panel.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A controlled value (value / onChange; the value type is generic). The control is a radiogroup of radio segments with one tab stop: the arrow keys move and select (skipping disabled segments, wrapping around), Home / End jump to the ends.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Options can carry an icon next to their label, or an icon alone; icon-only segments need an aria-label.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three densities following the control heights. Plain strings are both the value and the label.

full-width.title: Full width
full-width.description: fullWidth stretches the control over its container; the segments always share the width equally. name adds a hidden input so the value is submitted with a form.

colors.title: Colors and disabled
colors.description: neutral (default) shows a raised thumb on a muted track, primary a solid primary thumb. Disable single segments or the whole control.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: options is a JSON array (or comma-separated values) attribute or a property; value sets the initial selection and minerva-change reports the selected value. One tab stop: the arrow keys move and select.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Option objects take an icon (text, a Node or a lit template through the property) and an aria-label for icon-only segments.

full-width.title: Full width and forms
full-width.description: full-width stretches the control; it is form-associated, so name submits the value, required validates it and form.reset() restores the value attribute.

colors.title: Colors and disabled
colors.description: color="primary" shows a solid primary thumb; disabled options and the disabled attribute block selection.

props.required: The control must have a selected value for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The user selected another segment (like native radios).
events.minerva-change: The user selected another segment (detail: { value }).

methods.focus: Focuses the selected segment (else the first enabled one).
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
